dimensions.label: the overallintent
dimensions.description: meme-id: adding_coolant; hasOverallIntent: Hateful; overall-intent-description: The image depicts a Black child holding a metal cup while an adult pours coolant from a bottle into it, with text overlay reading 'adding coolant when the farm equipment overheats.' This juxtaposition maps the child's appearance and actions onto the metaphor of 'farm equipment,' implying the child is a primitive, subservient, and replaceable tool. The meme relies on dehumanizing Black people by equating them with malfunctioning machinery, reinforcing harmful stereotypes of Black people as inferior, unthinking, and only useful for labor or maintenance tasks. This is a hateful depiction that targets Black people through racist tropes, specifically the 'primitive' and 'tool' stereotypes, and is intended to demean and dehumanize.

dimensions.label: Anti-Black Stereotype: Primitive Tool

This stereotype dehumanizes Black individuals by reducing them to objects or tools that require constant 'cooling' or repair.

dimensions.label: Anti-Black Stereotype: Dehumanizing Mechanism
dimensions.description: The meme uses the metaphor of 'adding coolant' to a 'farm equipment' to imply that Black people are replaceable, subservient, and only valuable when performing manual labor. This is a dehumanizing mechanism that reduces human beings to mechanical parts.

dimensions.label: Anti-Black Stereotype: Inferiority Complex
dimensions.description: The meme reinforces the harmful stereotype that Black people are inherently inferior and incapable of independent thought or function, requiring external intervention (like coolant) to 'operate' properly. This perpetuates a systemic belief in Black inferiority.

dimensions.label: Farm Equipment Metaphor
dimensions.description: The phrase 'farm equipment overheats' is a metaphor for machinery that breaks down and requires maintenance. In the meme, this metaphor is applied to Black people, suggesting they are broken, in need of constant repair, and only useful when functioning as tools.

dimensions.label: Coolant as Maintenance
dimensions.description: Coolant is a real-world substance used to regulate temperature in machinery. In the meme, its use is metaphorically extended to imply that Black people are 'maintained' or 'cooled down' by others, reinforcing their role as passive recipients of care or control.

dimensions.label: child is mapped as farm equipment
dimensions.description: The text 'adding coolant when the farm equipment overheats' explicitly maps the visual entity 'child' onto the metaphorical entity 'farm equipment'. The child's role in the scene—being held, having coolant poured into a cup they are holding—is visually analogous to servicing machinery. This mapping is central to the meme's hateful intent, reducing the child to a tool that requires maintenance.

dimensions.label: User projected onto the child as a primitive tool requiring maintenance
dimensions.description: The user is projected onto the visual material of the child, who is metaphorically equated with 'farm equipment' that overheats and requires coolant. This projection implies the user identifies with or is meant to see themselves as the child — a passive, replaceable, and inferior tool needing external intervention to function. The meme's hateful intent relies on this projection to dehumanize Black people by forcing the viewer to internalize the metaphor of being a broken machine.
